messages:
angel-dev: Cutting RC rc-2026-03-20-1 now. Artifact: sha256:3b9f8a7dcd... link: https://ci.internal/release/rc-2026-03-20-1. Target prod promo window 17:00 UTC. Please +1 for promo after smoke.

mira-sre: @angel-dev tagging sheriff @mira-sre for 17:00 window. KV warmers on standby.

deploy-bot: [build 20260320.1] All checks: unit ✅ integration ✅ canary smoke ✅. Artifacts pinned: `sha256:3b9f8a7dcd`. /promote queued (manual approval required).

jo: QA note: ran fast-e2e in staging (generate, embeddings, rerank). Found a flake in rerank when payload >32kb, logged ENG-4291. Not blocking for initial promo but request extra observation.

ivor-eng: Heads up: pin model to `model-v1.4.3-quant` in release config. Without pin autosync will pick v1.5.0. Pushed pin in `release.yaml`.

paul-qa: QA conditional +1: smoke pass, e2e pass except rerank flake. Recommend canary at 10% for 15m then observe.

sana-product: Release notes draft: "- batching flag config; rerank: bug tracked ENG-4291; opt-in telemetry for KV cache." Draft: https://docs/releases/rc-2026-03-20.md

sylvia-ops: Rollback plan ready: revert to `sha256:9f8e4d2b` (20260312.4). KV cache flush playbook and deadman contacts listed. Low downtime risk.

deploy-bot: /promote rc-2026-03-20-1 -> prod scheduled at 2026-03-20T17:00Z. Manual "approve" starts promotion.

angel-dev: Approving now. /approve

deploy-bot: Promotion started: spinning up prod tasks, warming KV caches for `model-v1.4.3-quant`, priming prefix cache. Traffic plan: 10% -> 100% over 12m.

oncall: Watching prod metrics (latency, 5xx, token_cost). Increasing trace sampling to 100% for 10m on /generate.

deploy-bot: 17:03Z - 10% traffic -> prod variant `model-v1.4.3-quant`: OK. 17:08Z - 50% OK. 17:12Z - 100% OK. Post-promo smoke: 2xx stable.

paul-qa: Seeing occasional 500s on /generate under short bursts. Reproducible locally under high concurrency. Logs show: `model shard OOM` on some hosts. Tagging infra.

sylvia-ops: Executing partial traffic pin: route `/generate` -> fallback `model-v1.4.2-optimized` for 30% traffic to reduce mem pressure while we investigate. Applied routing override.

mira-sre: Good move. Collecting heap dumps from affected hosts now. Will open incident only if 5xx >1% sustained for 5m.

ivor-eng: Will push a micro-hotfix to reduce batch size threshold for `model-v1.4.3-quant` and run a canary once we have dumps.

deploy-bot: Traffic adjusted: `/generate` 30% -> `model-v1.4.2-optimized`, 70% -> `model-v1.4.3-quant`. No full rollback performed.

paul-qa: After pin, 500s dropped to noise. Running spot e2e checks now — green so far. Closing QA hold.

angel-dev: Summary: promotion succeeded. We applied a targeted traffic pin to `model-v1.4.2-optimized` for /generate to avoid OOMs — no full rollback. Artifact pinned: `sha256:3b9f8a7dcd`. Release notes: https://docs/releases/rc-2026-03-20.md. Thanks team :tada:

mira-sre: Added follow-up task ENG-4302 to add batch-size heuristic to runtime and improve OOM telemetry.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete at 17:25Z. Closing thread."
